summary: Two low ledges at Boothbay Harbor's mouth; a granite-piered fog signal (1892) with a wooden light tower added on its roof in 1907.

notes_for_editor: Disagreements stated in text: automation 1974 (USLHS, LighthouseFriends) vs 1975 (NRHP); dwelling destroyed 1978 blizzard (NRHP) vs demolished 1977 (NEL citing Coast Guard) vs vandalism demolition (LighthouseFriends); tripod 1874 (NEL) vs by 1888 (NRHP); deed April vs May 2006, and a 2020 Register article says lease. Trumpet class first-class (hours table) vs third-class (tests), 1894. Current ownership and access after Aug 2021 unverified: the Friends' NPS application outcome not found; USLHS still lists the Council as owner. Larson Alley (1969) appears via New England Lighthouses quote only; he is on the USLHS roster as assistant 1969 but no person slug link was made. Bulletin 1923 gives day and month of the Barbara W. rescue but no year in the passage read; 1922 is from LighthouseFriends. Roster lines are USLHS spans; Wolcott/Clarence/Preston Marr relationship not stated by any source. Page numbers: LHB 1893/1894 cited by scan page (printed pages not confirmed); Bulletin 1917 page 283 from the index. NRHP says Foss assistant 'H. E. Seavey' while roster has Harold E. Seavey (1930-1937) as assistant, consistent. Fact-check 2026-10-27: citations for LHB 1895/1900 and Bulletins 1917/1923/1930 changed to scan/PDF pages (1917 'p. 283' was the index's volume page).
